semantic_findings: Every genuine residual component receives an owner through an actual original boundary edge. Whole-component owner fibers cover and are pairwise disjoint; roots are never absorbed into other roots.

The maximum path is selected from a nonempty finite family of real supported simple paths. The singleton path is included. Splitting a simple path at the root at most once gives the two-sided intrinsic radius bound using only the explicit root-avoiding component path-mass premise.

The reserve is constructed from actual non-root critical-path vertices: use all of them when their count is small, otherwise an exact N-element subset. The short case uses a genuine connected-host internal-edge lower bound; the long case uses baseline credits and2K<=Nb. The root diameter credit is counted once. The external release inequality pays all absorbed vertices while retaining the stated future reserve.

The rooted graph uses actual residual edges and selected boundary ports. Root-avoiding walks transfer to an original residual component; whole-component connectivity constructs actual root walks. This discharges the abstract avoidance condition in the rooted payment theorem.

Variable cluster walk lifting gives literal original-host walks within each new branch. The selected root graph embeds in the real unit quotient. Replacing its connector count by the full quotient count uses a proved monotone cardinality comparison with c>=0, not an unproved equality.

The new family covers the host and inherits actual intrinsic radius bounds. The same global crossing embedding assigns distinct original unit connectors; disjoint filled index sets therefore have disjoint connector budgets.

The selected/residual mixed family keeps selected core branches and untouched old branches without splitting or duplicating old vertices. The original right-index preimage is injective and its cardinality equals the absorbed mixed-index cardinality.

Heavy-edge cost deliberately uses the original small-cluster incidence degree and original edge uniqueness/looplessness. It never assumes that contracting a large core preserves simple quotient degree. Every heavy edge incident to an absorbed residual branch belongs to the charged original touching-edge set.

The final mixed join retains coverage, intrinsic walks, old-root reserve and actual heavy-edge payment. New connector edges lie outside every old mixed branch, including selected-core interiors, preventing reuse of those internal connector credits.
explicit_scope: An actual old covering cluster family and an actual nonempty selected core family with its branch unions and intrinsic radii are inputs.
The connected coarse H is a subgraph of the actual unit quotient; the theorem does not assert H is acyclic.
The bound on every simple path in each actual residual component is the explicit small-component-case premise. It is not derived for an arbitrary residual graph.
Per-old-vertex credits, original heavy-edge degree/weight bounds, original cluster looplessness and uniqueness, and the numerical scale/reserve inequalities remain explicit.

The result is a finite covering paid next-family construction for this small-component case. Large-path endpoint absorption, the unconditional next-level split, deferred-edge accounting, simultaneous scale selection, global multilevel lightness, runtime and a whole-paper audit remain open.
source_correction_claim: No new original-paper defect is asserted or inferred.
gate_scope: Source-only semantic and exact-hash review. No compiler run by reviewer. Owner strict/root/audit/replay gates and exact successor full CI remain distinct.
